name: C3k (CSP block with k×k bottlenecks)

whatIsIt.eli5: A small team: half the notes go through two helpers, the other half skip, then they are joined.
whatIsIt.simple: A C3-style CSP block: two 1×1 Convs split the work, a chain of Bottlenecks (k×k kernels, default 3×3) runs on one branch, and a final 1×1 Conv joins both branches.
whatIsIt.engineer: C3 with Bottleneck(c_, c_, shortcut, g, k=(k, k), e=1.0) units; used inside C3k2 and A2C2f (a2=False).

whyExists.eli5: Two helpers in a row see a bigger area than one.
whyExists.simple: It gives each unit of C3k2 more depth and a wider view, while the skip branch keeps it cheap.
whyExists.engineer: Deeper unit with larger receptive field; CSP split halves compute.

eli5: Copy the notes into two piles.
One pile goes through two helpers.
simple: cv1 and cv2 (1×1 Convs) make two branches of half width.
Join the branches; cv3 (1×1) mixes them.
engineer: c_ = int(c2·e), e = 0.5 by default; inside C3k2 it is called with e = 0.5 on width c.
